title: Anime: Battle & Fantasy
description: Fighting, magic, isekai and heroic vocabulary. Heavy overlap with MTG flavor text.

words.sentence: {最後|さいご}まで[{戦|たたか}う]！
words.tip: 戦 contains 戈 (halberd). Same kanji as 戦場 (battlefield).

words.sentence: [{敵|てき}]が{来|く}るぞ！
{彼|かれ}は{敵|てき}か[{味方|みかた}]か？
words.tip: 味 (taste) + 方 (side): those who share your taste are on your side.

words.sentence: {必|かなら}ず[{勝|か}つ]！
words.tip: Sounds like 'cutlet' (カツ), which is why students eat katsu before exams.

words.sentence: {絶対|ぜったい}に[{負|ま}けない]！
words.tip: 負 = a person (⺈) carrying a shell (貝, money) on their back: burdened, defeated.

words.sentence: みんなを[{守|まも}る]！
words.tip: 宀 (roof) + 寸 (hand): a hand guarding the house.

words.sentence: {魔王|まおう}を[{倒|たお}す]！
もっと[{力|ちから}]が{欲|ほ}しい。
words.tip: Looks like a flexed arm.

words.sentence: [{魔法|まほう}]が{使|つか}える！
words.tip: 魔 (demon: 鬼 under a 麻 roof) + 法 (method): the demon's method.

words.sentence: [{魔王|まおう}]が{復活|ふっかつ}した。
[{勇者|ゆうしゃ}]よ、{目覚|めざ}めよ。
words.tip: 勇 (courage, has 力 power) + 者 (person).

words.sentence: {彼|かれ}はこの{国|くに}の[{英雄|えいゆう}]だ。
[{剣|けん}]を{抜|ぬ}け！
words.tip: The right side 刂 is a knife radical. Also read つるぎ in poetic names.

words.sentence: [{呪|のろ}い]を{解|と}く。
words.tip: Same 呪 as 呪文 (spell). Mouth 口 + a kneeling person chanting.

words.sentence: [{封印|ふういん}]が{解|と}けた！
words.tip: 封 (seal up) + 印 (stamp, mark).

words.sentence: {竜|りゅう}を[{召喚|しょうかん}]する！
words.tip: 召 (call) + 喚 (shout, has 口): call out loudly. 召喚酔い = summoning sickness.

words.sentence: {目|め}が{覚|さ}めたら[{異世界|いせかい}]にいた。
words.translation: When I woke up, I was in another world.
words.tip: 異 (different) + 世界 (world). The genre name.

words.sentence: {死|し}んだら[{転生|てんせい}]していた。
words.translation: After I died, I was reincarnated.
words.tip: 転 (turn, roll) + 生 (life): life rolls over.

words.sentence: [{復讐|ふくしゅう}]を{誓|ちか}う。
{仲間|なかま}を[{裏切|うらぎ}る]のか？
words.tip: 裏 (back side) + 切る (cut): to cut someone from behind.

words.sentence: こんな{所|ところ}で[{死|し}ぬ]わけにはいかない。
words.translation: I can't die in a place like this.

words.sentence: [{生|い}きろ]！
words.tip: 生 is a sprout pushing up from the ground.

words.sentence: [{命|いのち}]をかけて{守|まも}る。
words.translation: I'll protect you with my life.

words.sentence: [{血|ち}]が{出|で}ているぞ。
words.tip: A dish (皿) with a drop of blood on top.

words.sentence: [{傷|きず}]は{浅|あさ}い。
{今|いま}だ、[{必殺技|ひっさつわざ}]！
words.tip: 必 (certain) + 殺 (kill) + 技 (technique): the sure-kill technique.

words.sentence: {俺|おれ}が[{最強|さいきょう}]だ！
words.tip: 最 (most) + 強 (strong).

words.sentence: {山|やま}で[{修行|しゅぎょう}]する。
{力|ちから}が[{覚醒|かくせい}]した！
words.tip: 覚 (wake) + 醒 (sober up): fully awake.

words.sentence: これは[{王|おう}]の{命令|めいれい}だ。
words.tip: Three lines (heaven, people, earth) joined by one vertical: the king connects them.

words.sentence: [{姫|ひめ}]を{助|たす}けに{行|い}く。
words.translation: I'm going to rescue the princess.

words.sentence: このままでは{世界|せかい}が[{滅|ほろ}びる]。
words.translation: At this rate, the world will perish.
words.tip: 滅 has 氵 (water) + 火 (fire): extinguished.
